interface.description: Ethernet interface to monitor (e.g., eth0, ens33). Must correspond to a real network interface on the system.

speed_bps.description: Maximum network speed in bits per second, with optional k/m/g suffix (e.g., '100m', '1g'). Leave empty to omit (uses default detection or manual configuration).

speed_legacy.description: Maximum network speed using legacy numeric values: '10', '100', '64', '128', '256', '768', or '1540'. Provided for backward compatibility. Prefer speed_bps.

videomode.description: Video mode for curses display. Valid values: 'vga' (color), 'mono' (monochrome).
